title: TIDEWATER

line: The shelf is full of bottles with twenty ingredients. Tidewater has three. Water, glycerin, and an oil pressed from seed. Nothing that needs explaining. Nothing that needs a chart. Tidewater. Three things, and none of them is a promise.
